title: 黄仁勋谈CEO责任与AI乐观前景
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Many people appreciate your optimism and get excited by it.
segments.zh: 很多人欣赏你的乐观并为此振奋。

segments.en: But what if your optimism proves wrong in the end?
segments.zh: 但如果你的乐观最终被证明是错的呢？

segments.en: Then I can say that I did everything I could. And the reason for that is because not only my optimistic, I'm doing everything I can to create a technology
segments.zh: 那我可以说我已竭尽所能。原因在于我不仅乐观，更在全力创造一项技术，

segments.en: necessary to keep the industry safe, secure.
segments.zh: 以保障行业的安全与可靠。

segments.en: And so let's not talk about the future in a pessimistic way while we do nothing about it to prevent that from happening.
segments.zh: 所以，我们不要一边悲观地谈论未来，一边却无所作为去防止它发生。

segments.en: And so maybe I'm older and more parental.
segments.zh: 也许我年纪大了，更像家长心态。

segments.en: Don't just deliver to bad news.
Tell me what you're going to do about it. And so long as we can prove to ourselves that we're doing both sides of that coin,
segments.zh: 告诉我你打算怎么应对。只要我们能证明自己在兼顾两面，

segments.en: the optimistic future while safeguarding our way in doing so.
segments.zh: 既追求乐观的未来，又在过程中守护我们的方式。

segments.en: So long as we do both sides of that, I'm perfectly fine. After a whirlwind week of AIPOM, one thing was clear.
segments.zh: 只要我们兼顾这两面，我就完全没问题。在AIPOM旋风般的一周后，有一件事很清楚。

segments.en: Jensen Wong has been the leading evangelist for an extraordinary new age of artificial intelligence.
segments.zh: 黄仁勋一直是人工智能非凡新时代的主要倡导者。

segments.en: In Vidya, the US economy, maybe even the entire global financial system might just rest on his optimism and accomplishments.
segments.zh: 在英伟达，美国经济，甚至整个全球金融体系可能都依赖于他的乐观和成就。

segments.en: But now, Wong himself is under scrutiny. He has led the business since its very beginning 33 years ago.
segments.zh: 但现在，黄仁勋本人正受到审视。自33年前公司创立以来，他一直领导着这家企业。

segments.en: And even as in Vidya grew into one of the world's most powerful companies, there's still no one designated to potentially replace him.
segments.zh: 尽管英伟达已成长为全球最强大的公司之一，但仍没有指定任何人可能接替他。
